findings.claim: CFTC 26-17 names XRP as a digital commodity and provides a conditional CFM/CBBM/Deribit customer-asset transfer and right-of-reuse path for specified 30.7 positions.
CFTC 26-17 condition 9 imports CFTC 26-05 asset qualification, notice, initial-period, haircut and risk-policy conditions.

CFTC 26-05 restricts the first three months from an FCM's own commencement date to payment stablecoins, BTC and ETH. After that, XRP is not automatically eligible: it must meet the qualifying clearing-organization route or the fallback route, which requires at least a 20% haircut and revised risk policies filed before accepting non-BTC/ETH/non-stablecoin assets.
The same-asset exception does not apply to XRP collateral for an XRP-USDC linear contract because that contract is not both based on and denominated in XRP.
Deribit says it has no connected clearing house or clearing members and describes a quasi-clearing/insurance-fund model.

Whether Deribit satisfies the precise CPMI-IOSCO foreign-clearing-organization qualification in 26-05 is unresolved. The CFTC 26-17 letter calls Deribit a foreign clearing organization in the CFM structure, while Deribit's own policy describes quasi-clearing rather than a connected clearing house.

CFM's notice date, expiry of the initial three-month restriction, revised risk-policy filing, post-October CBBM warm-wallet activation, CFM U.S. customer XRP enablement and actual XRP collateral balances remain unknown.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Deribit satisfies the 26-05 qualifying foreign-clearing-organization condition for XRP and CFM may apply Deribit's venue haircut after the initial period.
disconfirming: Deribit's policy describes no connected clearing house/members; the exact CPMI-IOSCO jurisdiction test is unresolved.
competing_hypotheses.test: Find direct regulatory/legal evidence of Deribit's qualification and CFM's filed risk policy.

competing_hypotheses.statement: If the qualifying clearing route is not met, CFM could accept XRP only through the 26-05 fallback after the initial period, with at least 20% haircut and revised risk policies.
competing_hypotheses.test: Find CFM WinJammer notice and revised policy.

competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP is listed as a Deribit cross-collateral asset but not enabled for CFM U.S. customer accounts.
competing_hypotheses.test: Verify customer account settings and post-integration Q4 collateral disclosures.
